reasons: The JACKETEK target fit is relaxed / baggy.
The live product direction is visually closer to a dropped shoulder (the website describes "Standard Baggy Fit — roomy and relaxed, with a dropped shoulder").
The S.i.-based canonical technical flat already uses a dropped shoulder.
Golden Bear remains a fit / grading benchmark only; its set-in shoulder construction is not authoritative for JACKETEK.
shoulderConstruction.notApproved: No shoulder or sleeve measurement is approved by this decision.
shoulderConstruction.shoulderPoint: On the JACKETEK garment the shoulder point (SP) is where the sleeve-attachment (armhole) seam line crosses the shoulder line — the shoulder seam extended to the top fold with the garment laid flat. It sits below and outside the wearer's natural shoulder; its exact position is set by the pattern maker.
shoulderConstruction.goldenBear: Golden Bear's set-in values stay FIT_REFERENCE / EXTERNAL_REFERENCE (not deleted). Its shoulder (B09) and sleeve (S01) values are NOT directly transferable to the dropped-shoulder construction without pattern / sample validation.
shoulderConstruction.siFlat: Compatible: the canonical flat (garment-spec/working-varsity-flat, from the purchased S.i. page, unedited source) is drawn with a dropped shoulder — its shoulder points SP_L / SP_R sit on the body–sleeve seam well below and outside HPS (front: SP y ≈ 289 vs HPS y ≈ 213, drawing units, not to scale). The RFQ's B09 / S02 POM lines and the sleeve-zone unit (shoulder point → cuff seam = S02 − S09) already start at that dropped seam. No drawing change needed.

conflicts.title: Sleeve: centre back vs shoulder seam
conflicts.detail: Golden Bear measures from centre back (S01, 90.17 cm M). The supplied chart measures from the shoulder seam (51 cm M, end point unknown). Different start points: the two numbers are never compared, combined or averaged. Arithmetic only: GB S01 − ½ GB B09 = 65.41 cm, ≈ 14 cm more than 51 cm — far more than a cuff rib, so the supplied chart's end point (cuff seam? elbow? underarm length?) or start point (a dropped shoulder seam) differs.
conflicts.result: MEASUREMENT METHOD CONFLICT / SAMPLE REQUIRED — no JACKETEK sleeve target.

conflicts.status: DECISION MADE — K1 = DROPPED_SHOULDER (2026-10-10); measurement consequences remain open
conflicts.title: Shoulder construction (K1) moves the shoulder point
conflicts.detail: JACKETEK uses a DROPPED SHOULDER. Golden Bear Classic is a set-in block; whether the supplied chart's jacket is dropped is unknown. On a dropped shoulder the shoulder point moves down the arm: across shoulder grows and sleeve-from-shoulder-point shrinks for the same body. Golden Bear's B09 and any set-in shoulder-point sleeve value are therefore not transferable.
conflicts.result: K1 resolved. B09 / B10 → TBD_PATTERN_MAKER (shoulder point placed by the pattern maker); S01 / S02 measured on the sample from the dropped shoulder point; no new cm values.
